transcript: this show will literally solve all of your problems or at least it'll try it's called HA HA HA HA HA HA HA that's seven “HA”s don't you dare mess it up and basically, it's this strange but surprisingly wholesome communal theatrical experience where the artist Julia Masli asks audience members to tell her a problem that they're having in their life and she does whatever she can to fix it right then and there or find someone else in the audience who can at my performance someone got an actual haircut on stage and someone else got neck treatment from an actual massage therapist people exchanged words of wisdom words of encouragement one girl said she missed performing so Masli brought her up on stage and had her help out through the rest of the show and nothing I just said is a spoiler because it's literally different every time there are some prepared elements of the show which I won't mention in detail but word of wisdom maybe consider bringing an extra pair of socks it'll be fine if you don't though this is honestly the kind of thing that I find most exciting in the modern theatrical landscape I loved it in a similar way that I love things like Burnout Paradise or the Neofuturists where it genuinely feels like live theater at its most live and it's able to do that not with huge spectacle but by going back to like the bare essential form of theater of people sharing an experience in a room all that to say HA HA HA HA HA HA HA is running at the Public through June 29th if it sounds like your kind of thing I really wouldn't miss this
showTitle: HA HA HA HA HA HA HA (Julia Masli)
classificationReason: Creator attended Julia Masli's immersive off-Broadway show and shares first-hand opinion ('I loved it'). Burnout Paradise is referenced only as a comparison. Primary show not in list.
